cards.speaker: James
cards.text: I want {faction} warmed up to us inside a fortnight. We both want the same ground, and a firm that's quarrelling over ground loses buyers. Favours, a gift, a fair deal. It's cheaper than the argument we're heading for.

cards.speaker: James
cards.text: I'd like {faction} on better terms with us by the end of next week. Not friends. Civil. They'll move on us sooner or later, and a faction that has been shown a courtesy moves slower.

cards.speaker: James
cards.text: Let's get ahead of {faction}. I want their opinion of us improved this fortnight, before our veins start overlapping with theirs in earnest. A raid costs a month. A courtesy costs an afternoon.
